rewards.fightScript: AddEvent("Resurrection",()=>{Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])+9).ToString();}); AddEvent<HurtData>("Hurt",(fromdata)=>{ if (int.Parse(fromdata.val)<Self.MaxHp/20) { return; } if (int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])<=0) { return; } Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])-1).ToString(); UpdateRelicShow(); ChangeHp((int.Parse(fromdata.val)+Self.MaxHp/20).ToString());});

AddEvent<HurtData>("Hurt",(hurtData) => {    if (hurtData.sourceId==Self.InstanceId)    {        return;    } SetStatusById(hurtData.sourceId); if (Object.Count() > 0) { var ThisStatus = Object[0]; var buffs=ThisStatus.GetBuffs(); if (buffs==null) { return; } var tempList=buffs.Where(x => x.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Type"] == "负面").ToList(); SetStatus("Self"); ChangeHp((tempList.Count().ToString())); SetStatusById(ThisStatus.InstanceId); foreach (var item in tempList) { AddBuff(item.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Id"],"1"); } } });

SetStatus("AllTarget"); Resentment("3"); SetStatus("Self"); AddEvent("EndRound",()=>{SetStatus("AllTarget"); var tempList=new List<IStatusManager>(Object); foreach (var tempStatus in tempList) { if (tempStatus == null) { return; } var buffs=tempStatus.GetBuffs(); if (buffs==null) { return; } buffs=buffs.Where(x=>x.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Type"]=="负面").ToArray();  int Length=buffs.Length; int count=buffs.Length; foreach (var item in buffs) { AddBuff(item.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Id"],count.ToString()); } } });

SetStatus("Self"); AddEvent<AddBuffData>("AddBuff",(d)=>{ if(d.data.data["Type"]!="负面")return; if(d.fromId!=Self.InstanceId&&d.toId!=Self.InstanceId)return; if(HandCard.Count==0)return; int idx=DefaultDice.WithRange(0,HandCard.Count-1).Roll().Value; var c=HandCard[idx].dataConfig; c.Vars["OnceExCost"]=(int.Parse(c.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("OnceExCost","0"))-1).ToString(); HandCard[idx].DataUpdate(); });

SetStatus("Self");        AddEvent<AddBuffData>("AddBuff",(d)=>{ if(d.data.data["Type"]!="负面")return;  if(d.fromId!=Self.InstanceId||d.dataFromid==dataConfig.data["Id"])return; SetStatusById(d.toId);  AddBuff(DataId.buff_burn, "1");});

SetStatus("All"); AddEvent<AddBuffData>("AddBuff",(d)=>{ if(d.data.data["Type"]!="负面")return; if(d.toId==Self.InstanceId)return; Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse( Vars["ThisCount"])+1).ToString(); if (int.Parse( Vars["ThisCount"])%2==0) {    SetStatus("Self"); RandomAddGoodBuff("1"); }  });

ChangeDynamicVarPercent("AttackedPercentDamage","40"); ChangeDynamicVarPercent("DefendPercent","-40"); ChangeDynamicVarPercent("HealMultiplier","-50"); ChangeDynamicVar("RoundCard","1"); AddEvent("FightStart",()=>{SetStatus("Self");AddBuff(DataId.buff_degrade,"3");DrawCount("3"); if (PlayerInfo.Level>18) {    foreach (var item in PlayerInfo.CardList) {    item.Vars["ExCost"]=(int.Parse(item.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("ExCost","0"))-1).ToString(); } }  }); AddEvent("EndRound",()=>{SetStatus("Self");RandomAddGoodBuff("2","0");ChangeHp((-Self.CurHp/10).ToString());}); AddEvent("Win",()=>{if(PlayerInfo.Money>0){PlayerInfo.Money-=System.Math.Max(1,PlayerInfo.Money/10);}}); AddEvent("StartRound",()=>{ int curseCount=HandCard.Count(x=>x.data["Tag"].Contains("Curse")); curseCount+=DeckCard.Count(x=>x.data["Tag"].Contains("Curse")); curseCount+=UsedCard.Count(x=>x.data["Tag"].Contains("Curse")); if(!PlayerInfo.SpecialVars.ContainsKey("SevenCursePower"))PlayerInfo.SpecialVars["SevenCursePower"]="0"; PlayerInfo.SpecialVars["SevenCursePower"]=(int.Parse(PlayerInfo.SpecialVars["SevenCursePower"])+curseCount).ToString(); Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(PlayerInfo.SpecialVars ["SevenCursePower"])/2).ToString(); UpdateRelicShow(); });

if(Self==null||!PlayerInfo.RelicList.Any(x=>x.data["Id"]==DataId.CrowdFundingRelic_12))return; SetStatus("AllTarget"); AddEvent<HurtData>("Hurt",(d)=>{ if(d.sourceId!=Self.InstanceId)return; if(CheckDice.Roll().Value<=93)return; int negTypeCount=0; var buffs=Self.GetBuffs(); if(buffs==null) return; negTypeCount+=buffs.Where(x=>x.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Type"]=="负面").Select(x=>x.buffConfig.BuffId).Distinct().Count();  int gain=(negTypeCount+7)*2; SetStatus("Self"); AddBuff(DataId.buff_extraordinary,gain.ToString()); AddBuff(DataId.buff_evergreen,(gain/2).ToString()); });

Vars["ThisCount"]="0";        AddEvent("FightStart",()=>{SetStatus("Self");AddBuff(DataId.buff_revelation,"3");}); AddEvent("Action",()=>{    Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])+1).ToString(); SetStatus("Self"); var br=Self.GetBuff(DataId.buff_revelation); if(br!=null) { ChangeDefence(br.buffConfig.Level.ToString()); } });

AddEvent<BurnData>("BurnCard",(from)=>{ SetStatus("Self"); AddBuff(DataId.buff_revelation,"1");        if (TagCheck(from.data,"Combo"))        {   AddBuff(DataId.buff_revelation,"1");        }      });        AddEvent("buff_revelationOnLevelChange", () =>        {   if (Self==null||Self.GetBuff("buff_revelation")==null)   {return;   }   AddBuff(DataId.buff_extraordinary,(Self.GetBuff("buff_revelation").buffConfig.Level/5*20).ToString());        });

Vars["Stack"]="0"; SetStatus("AllTarget"); AddEvent<HurtData>("Hurt",(d)=>{ if(d.sourceId!=Self.InstanceId)return; Vars["Stack"]=(int.Parse(Vars["Stack"])+1).ToString(); SetStatus("Self"); ChangeDynamicVarPercent("PercentDamage","10"); }); SetStatus("Self"); AddEvent("Hurt",()=>{ int s=int.Parse(Vars["Stack"]); if(s<=0)return; ChangeDynamicVarPercent("PercentDamage",(-10*s).ToString()); Vars["Stack"]="0"; });

AddEvent("StartRound",()=>{ if(HandCard.Count==0)return; int idx=DefaultDice.WithRange(0,HandCard.Count-1).Roll().Value; int dec=DefaultDice.WithRange(1,3).Roll().Value; var c=HandCard[idx].dataConfig; c.Vars["OnceExCost"]=(int.Parse(c.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("OnceExCost","0"))-dec).ToString(); HandCard[idx].DataUpdate(); });

SetStatus("Self"); AddEvent<ActionData>("Action",(d)=>{ int chance=int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"]); if(CheckDice.Roll().Value>100-chance) { ChangeDynamicVar("UseCount","1"); chance=System.Math.Max(20,chance-20); Vars["ThisCount"]=chance.ToString(); UpdateRelicShow(); } });

Vars["Used2"] = "0"; Vars["Used3"] = "0"; SetStatus("Self"); AddEvent<ActionData>("Action", (d) => { int cost = int.Parse(d.data.data["Expend"]); if (cost == 3 && Vars["Used3"] == "0" && HandCard.Count > 0) { Vars["Used3"] = "1"; ChooseCardToAction("1", (cards) => { if (cards.Count > 0) { var c = cards[0].dataConfig; c.Vars["ExCost"] = (int.Parse(c.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("ExCost", "0")) - 2).ToString(); cards[0].DataUpdate(); } }); } else if (cost == 2 && Vars["Used2"] == "0" && HandCard.Count > 0) { Vars["Used2"] = "1"; ChooseCardToAction("1", (cards) => { if (cards.Count > 0) { var c = cards[0].dataConfig; c.Vars["ExCost"] = (int.Parse(c.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("ExCost", "0")) - 1).ToString(); cards[0].DataUpdate(); } });; } });

Vars["RetainAdd"]="0"; bool UniqueDeck() { var names=PlayerInfo.CardList.Select(x=>x.data["Name"]).ToList(); return names.Distinct().Count()==names.Count; } if (UniqueDeck()) { Vars["RetainAdd"]="1"; ChangeDynamicVar("RetainCard","999"); } AddEvent("StartRoundEnd",()=>{ if (Vars["RetainAdd"]=="0") { return; } foreach(var card in HandCard) { card.dataConfig.Vars["OnceExCost"]=(int.Parse(card.dataConfig.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("OnceExCost","0"))-1).ToString(); card.DataUpdate(); } });

AddEvent("StartRound", () => { FightRelicCheck((list, id) => {    list=list.Where(x => x.data["Name"].Contains("奥罗拉")).ToList();    for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)    {        SetStatusById(id); AddBuff(DataId.buff_extraordinary, "10");    }     }); });

AddEvent("StartRound", () => { FightRelicCheck((list, id) => {list=list.Where(x => x.data["Name"].Contains("奥罗拉")).ToList();    for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)    { SetStatusById(id); AddBuff(DataId.buff_resilient, "3"); } }); });

AddEvent("StartRound", () => { FightRelicCheck((list, id) => {list=list.Where(x => x.data["Name"].Contains("奥罗拉")).ToList();    for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)    { SetStatusById(id); ChangeDefence("10"); } }); });
AddEvent("FightStart", () => { FightRelicCheck((list, id) => { if (list.Any(x => x.data["Name"].Contains("奥罗拉"))) { SetStatusById(id); AddBuff(DataId.buff_cycle, "1"); } }); });
AddEvent("FightStart", () => { FightRelicCheck((list, id) => { if (list.Any(x => x.data["Name"].Contains("奥罗拉"))) { SetStatusById(id); AddBuff(DataId.buff_impregnable, "1"); } }); });
AddEvent("FightStart", () => { FightRelicCheck((list, id) => { if (list.Any(x => x.data["Name"].Contains("奥罗拉"))) { SetStatusById(id); AddBuff(DataId.buff_elements, "10"); } }); });

AddEvent<ScriptExecuteData>(EventType.ScriptExecute.ToString(), data => { if (data.Executor == null || data.Arguments == null || data.Arguments.Length == 0) { return; } if (!string.Equals(data.MethodName, "Damage", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return; } if (data.Executor.Self == null || data.Executor.Self.IsNull() || data.Executor.Self.InstanceId != Self.InstanceId) { return; } if (data.Executor.dataConfig?.data == null || !data.Executor.dataConfig.data.TryGetValue("Id", out var sourceDataId)) { return; } if (sourceDataId == dataConfig.data["Id"]) { return; } var baseValue = data.Arguments[0]?.ToString(); if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(baseValue)) { return; } int extraPercent = 0; var tempList = new List<IStatusManager>(data.Executor.Object); foreach (var item in tempList) { if (item == null || item.IsNull()) { continue; } var buffs = item.GetBuffs(); if (buffs == null) { continue; } extraPercent += buffs.Where(x => x != null && x.buffConfig != null && x.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Type"] == "负面").Select(x => x.buffConfig.BuffId).Distinct().Count() * 10; } if (extraPercent <= 0) { return; } data.Arguments[0] = (baseValue.ToInt() * (100 + extraPercent) / 100).ToString(); });

AddEvent<HurtData>("Hurt",(d)=>{if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(d.sourceId)||d.sourceId==Self.InstanceId)return;SetStatusById(d.sourceId);if(Object.Count()>0){AddBuff(DataId.buff_burn,"2");}});AddEvent("Resurrection",()=>{SetStatus("AllTarget");var tempList=new List<IStatusManager>(Object);foreach(var t in tempList){if(t==null||t.IsNull())continue;SetStatusById(t.InstanceId);AddBuff(DataId.buff_burn,"12");var buffs=t.GetBuffs();if(buffs==null)continue;foreach(var buff in buffs.Where(x=>x!=null&&x.buffConfig!=null&&x.buffConfig.dataConfig.data["Type"]=="负面").ToList()){RunImmediately(buff.buffConfig.BuffId,"Action");RunImmediately(buff.buffConfig.BuffId,"StartRound");}}});
AddEvent("OnDiceCheck", () => { CheckDice.OnRoll += result => { var r2 = CheckDice.InternalRoll(); new Dice.State(Math.Max(result.Value, r2.Value), result.Bonus).CopyTo(result); }; });

AddEvent("FightStart", () => { FightRelicCheck((list, id) => { if (list.Any(x => x.data["Id"] == "CrowdFundingRelic_47")) { PlayerInfo.TempStrength += 5; PlayerInfo.TempWisdom += 5; PlayerInfo.TempPerceive += 5; PlayerInfo.TempLucky += 5; } }); });

AddEvent("FightStart", () =>        {   ChangeMaxPower("1");   for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)   {int count=DefaultDice.WithRange(1,99).Roll().Value;if (count>=100){    count=99;}var temp=new DataConfig("SpellCard_"+(count/25+1),DataType.Card);CreateCard(temp);   }        });

AddEvent("StartRound", () =>        {   for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)   {int count=DefaultDice.WithRange(1,99).Roll().Value;if (count>=100){    count=99;}var temp=new DataConfig("SpellCard_"+(count/25+1),DataType.Card);CreateCard(temp);   }        });

Vars["ThisCount"]="0";        AddEvent<ActionData>("Action", (ActionData fromdata) =>        {   Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])+1).ToString();   UpdateRelicShow();   if (int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])%3==0)   {foreach (var item in HandCard){    var tags=FightCardManager.Instance.CardTags.ContainsKey(item.dataConfig)?FightCardManager.Instance.CardTags[item.dataConfig]:null;    bool hasCombo=(tags!=null&&tags.Contains("Combo"))||(item.Vars.ContainsKey("SpecialTag")&&item.Vars["SpecialTag"].Contains("Combo"));    if (!hasCombo&&item.dataConfig.InstanceID!=fromdata.data.InstanceID)    {item.Vars["SpecialTag"]=string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("SpecialTag",""))?"Combo":item.Vars["SpecialTag"]+",Combo";        item.RefreshTag();        break;    }}   }        });        AddEvent("FightStart",()=>{AddBuff(DataId.buff_rebirth,"50");});        AddEvent("Resurrection",()=>{PlayerInfo.RemoveRelic("CrowdFundingRelic_54");});

SetStatus("Self");        AddEvent("BeforeDead", () =>        {   if (int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])>=10)   {SetStatus("Self");AddBuff(DataId.buff_rebirth,"100");SetStatus("AllTarget");AddBuff("buff_burn","20");Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])-10).ToString();UpdateRelicShow();   }        });        AddEvent("BurnCard", () =>        {   Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])+2).ToString();   if (int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])>10)   {Vars["ThisCount"]="10";   }   UpdateRelicShow();    });        AddEvent("buff_timelockOnTriggerEffect", () =>        {   Vars["ThisCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])+1).ToString();   if (int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"])>10)   {Vars["ThisCount"]="10";   }   UpdateRelicShow();        });

Vars["ThisCount"]="0";        var tempList=GetcardsByRarity("1","3").Where(x=>x["Tag"].Contains("Combo")).ToList();        if (tempList.Count==0)        {   return;        }        AddEvent("StartRound", () =>        {        int count=DefaultDice.WithRange(0,tempList.Count()-1).Roll().Value;   AddCardById(tempList[count]["Id"]);        }); AddEvent("buff_revelationOnLevelChange", () =>        {   if (Self==null||Self.GetBuff("buff_revelation")==null)   {return;   }   var buff=Self.GetBuff("buff_revelation");   if (buff.buffConfig.Level>int.Parse(Vars["ThisCount"]))   {Vars["ThisCount"]=buff.buffConfig.Level.ToString();int count =CheckDice.Roll().Value;if (count>95){    int index=DefaultDice.WithRange(0,tempList.Count()-1).Roll().Value;   DataConfig newData=new DataConfig(tempList[index]["Id"],DataType.Card);        newData.Vars["TotalExCost"]="-1";        CreateCard(newData);}   }        });

AddEvent("StartRound", () =>        {   var cardList=GetcardsOutLock().Where(x=>x["Id"].StartsWith("elementscard")).ToList();   if (cardList.Count()==0)   {return;   }   string TarId=cardList[DefaultDice.WithRange(0,cardList.Count()-1).Roll().Value]["Id"];   AddCard(TarId);   if (PlayerInfo.GetCareer()!=null)   {if (PlayerInfo.GetCareer().data["Id"]=="career_1"||PlayerInfo.GetCareer().data["Id"]=="career_9"){    TarId=cardList[DefaultDice.WithRange(0,cardList.Count()-1).Roll().Value]["Id"];   AddCard(TarId);   DrawCount("1");}   }        });

AddEvent<BurnData>("BurnCard",(burnData)=>{            DataConfig config=burnData.data as DataConfig;            if (config.Vars["Tag"].Contains("Curse"))            {                return;            }            int baseCount=CheckDice.Roll().Value;            if (baseCount>80)            {                AddCardToFightManager(config);            }        });

Vars["ThisGet"]="0"; SetStatus("Self"); AddEvent("Resurrection",() => { if (Vars["ThisGet"]=="0"&&CheckDice.Roll().Value>85) { Vars["ThisGet"]="1"; } }); SetStatus("AllTarget"); AddEvent("Dead",() => { if (Vars["ThisGet"]=="1") { PlayerInfo.RandomAddBless("1"); if (CheckDice.Roll().Value>80) { PlayerInfo.RandomAddRelic("1"); } } });

Vars["Used"]="0"; AddEvent("FightStart",() => { SetStatus("Self"); ChangeDynamicVar("liveCount","1"); }); AddEvent("Resurrection",() => { if (Vars["Used"]=="0") { Vars["Used"]="1"; SetStatus("AllFriends"); int friendCount = Object.Count; SetStatus("Self"); SetHp((Self.MaxHp*friendCount/4).ToString()); } });

AddEvent<HurtData>("Hurt", (data) =>        {            if (data.sourceId==Self.InstanceId)            {                return;            }            SetStatusById(data.sourceId);            if (Object.Count == 0)            {                return;            }            if (CheckDice.Roll().Value > 50)            {                AddBuff(DataId.buff_resentment, "1");            }            if (CheckDice.Roll().Value > 50)            {                var b = Object[0].GetBuff(DataId.buff_bleeding);                if (b != null)                {                    RunImmediately(DataId.buff_bleeding, "Action");                }                var burn = Object[0].GetBuff(DataId.buff_burn);                if (burn != null)                {                    RunImmediately(DataId.buff_burn, "Action");                }            }        });

if (!PlayerInfo.RelicList.Any(x=>x.data["Id"]==DataId.CrowdFundingRelic_12)) { return; }SetStatus("AllTarget"); AddEvent("Dead",() => { SetStatus("Self"); ChangeHp((Self.MaxHp/2).ToString()); List<string>choose=PlayerInfo.ChooseVars; if (choose.Count==0) {    return; }  int value=DefaultDice.Roll().Value; string tar=""; if (choose.Count==2) {    tar=value>50?choose[0]:choose[1]; } else {    tar=choose[0]; } if (tar=="Strength") {    PlayerInfo.Strength+=1; } if (tar=="Wisdom") {    PlayerInfo.Wisdom+=1; } if (tar=="Perceive") {    PlayerInfo.Perceive+=1; } if (tar=="Lucky") {    PlayerInfo.Lucky+=1; } });

Vars["Round"]="0"; AddEvent("EndRound",() => { Vars["Round"]=(int.Parse(Vars["Round"])+1).ToString(); if (int.Parse(Vars["Round"])<=5) { SetStatus("Self"); int lost = Self.MaxHp-Self.CurHp; if (lost>0) { ChangeHp((lost/5).ToString()); } } });

AddEvent("StartRound",() => {Vars["ThisCount"]="0";}); AddEvent("CostPower",() => { if (Vars["ThisCount"]=="0"&&PlayerInfo.Power==0) { Vars["ThisCount"]="1"; int before = HandCard.Count; DrawCount("3"); int drawed = HandCard.Count-before; int gain = 0; for (int i = HandCard.Count-drawed; i < HandCard.Count; i++) { if (i<0||i>=HandCard.Count) { continue; } var card = HandCard[i]; int cost = Math.Min((int)(int.Parse(card.data["Expend"]) * Self.dynamicVariables.GetValueOrDefault("CardCost", 1)), 4); cost += int.Parse(card.dataConfig.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("TotalExCost", "0")); cost += int.Parse(card.dataConfig.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("ExCost", "0")); cost += int.Parse(card.dataConfig.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("OnceExCost", "0")); if (cost>0) { gain += cost; } } if (gain>0) { ChangePower(gain.ToString()); } } });

Vars["TrueDamageCount"]="0"; Vars["TrueDamageGain"]="0"; Vars["PowerCostCount"]="0"; Vars["PowerGain"]="0"; SetStatus("AllTarget"); AddEvent<HurtData>("Hurt", (data) => { if (data.sourceId==Self.InstanceId&&data.damageType=="Normal"&&int.Parse(Vars["TrueDamageGain"])<10) { Vars["TrueDamageCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["TrueDamageCount"])+int.Parse(data.val)).ToString(); while (int.Parse(Vars["TrueDamageCount"])>=100&&int.Parse(Vars["TrueDamageGain"])<10) { Vars["TrueDamageCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["TrueDamageCount"])-100).ToString(); Vars["TrueDamageGain"]=(int.Parse(Vars["TrueDamageGain"])+1).ToString(); PlayerInfo.Strength += 1; } } }); SetStatus("Self"); AddEvent<ActionData>("Action",(actionData)=>{ if (int.Parse(Vars["PowerGain"])<10) { int cost = int.Parse(actionData.data.data["Expend"]); cost = System.Math.Min((int)(cost*Self.dynamicVariables.GetValueOrDefault("CardCost",1)),4); if (RoleTable.Instance.enchasedDict.ContainsKey(actionData.data.InstanceID)) { var ench = RoleTable.Instance.enchasedDict[actionData.data.InstanceID]; if (ench!=null&&ench.Vars["Tag"].Contains("Exhaustion")) { cost += 1; } } cost += int.Parse(actionData.data.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("ExCost","0")); cost += int.Parse(actionData.data.Vars.GetValueOrDefault("OnceExCost","0")); if (cost>0) { Vars["PowerCostCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["PowerCostCount"])+cost).ToString(); while (int.Parse(Vars["PowerCostCount"])>=20&&int.Parse(Vars["PowerGain"])<10) { Vars["PowerCostCount"]=(int.Parse(Vars["PowerCostCount"])-20).ToString(); Vars["PowerGain"]=(int.Parse(Vars["PowerGain"])+1).ToString(); PlayerInfo.Wisdom += 1; } } } });

Vars["Round"]="0"; Vars["Applied"]="0"; AddEvent("StartRound",() => { Vars["Round"]=(int.Parse(Vars["Round"])+1).ToString(); SetStatus("Self"); if (int.Parse(Vars["Round"])<=3) { if (Vars["Applied"]=="0") { Vars["Applied"]="1"; ChangeMaxPower("1"); } } else { if (Vars["Applied"]=="1") { Vars["Applied"]="0"; ChangeMaxPower("-1"); } AddBuff(DataId.buff_bleeding,"1"); } });

AddEvent("EndRound",() => {        SetStatus("Self");        int count=(Self.MaxHp-Self.CurHp)/100;        if (count<=0)        {            count=1;        }        ChangeHp(count.ToString());        });
